public_rationale: Primary records establish participation by several major banks and a quarterly corporate loss at CoreWeave. They do not establish hundreds of millions of exposure for every major institution, or losses at each financed data center after it opens. The compound claim therefore remains unsettled. Its undefined institution universe and accounting basis also prevent a firm verdict.
limitations: Syndicated financing disclosures do not necessarily reveal retained lender exposure.
Corporate accounts combine facilities, financing costs and other operations.
The project-loss wording is qualified and imprecise.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Every single major bank and financial institution has put hundreds of millions if not billions of dollars into building data centers that take forever to start generating money and then only seem to lose it.
conditions: every single major bank and financial institution

statement.excerpt: Every single major bank and financial institution has piled hundreds of millions if not billions of dollars into building data centers that take forever to even start generating money, at which point they only seem to lose it.

from_speaker: Every single major bank and financial institution
hundreds of millions if not billions of dollars
take forever to even start generating money
our_interpretation: Read this as a universal claim about major financial institutions financing AI data-center construction, followed by a general claim of long revenue lead times and losses after operation begins.
The adjacent context suggests roughly one to three years rather than literally forever.
Separate an institution's own funded or committed exposure from arranging or underwriting a larger syndicated facility.
Read losing money as losses after relevant costs, not merely construction spending exceeding early revenue.
Use July–September 2025, the latest completed reporting quarter before publication, for ongoing operating results and the quarter-end exposure position.
The passage gives no defined institution universe or accounting basis.
criteria.support_condition: Institution-by-institution records establish at least hundreds of millions of dollars of qualifying exposure for every major institution in the intended universe, and matching project records establish long pre-revenue construction periods and subsequent losses.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A verified major institution has less than the claimed qualifying exposure, or matching project-level records establish a material exception to the claimed operating pattern. A missing deal announcement alone is not an exception.

evidence.explanation: The disclosure confirms participation by several major banks. Membership does not establish each bank's funded amount or exposure across the whole institution universe.
CoreWeave reported a company-level quarterly net loss. That does not establish the profitability of each financed facility, losses for lenders, or the universal exposure assertion.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A defined institution universe, comparable exposure records and matched project construction and financial data, with an identified accounting basis.
